description: I am an student in class 10. I have been interested in playing with Hardware, Event Horizon study along with probability of Quantum mechanic and Atomic level of study.
summary:
We have made Smart green house which uses ESP32 and different sensors. 
Temperature sensor is used to send reading to webpage and open the cooling agent in necessary.
TDS sensor help to map out the concentration of Ions inside the soil and send reading to webpage then turning on pump to send out fertilizer to soil if necessary.
Gas sensor help to map  out  over all gas health in the score of 10 and  send reading to webpage.
This page is accessable for all groups of farmer because of its simple layout and UI. This can be also used in remote area because it can use its SIM to send SMS to user over a long distance.
details: We have used ESP 32 as brain and contoller of other sensor. Temperature sensor helps to mapout temperature and maintain it. TDS sensor help to find the concentration of ions and pour fertilizer if necessary. Where Gas sensor rate the gas in over all the score of 10 in webpage. We have used C++ for ESP logics and HTML for simple UI and webpage.
dataRefs: Green house effect and healthy green house factor.
